mission: Select feature-family combinations for future generalization without treating all available data as automatically useful.
pit_rule: participant/team attributes and event-participant context are eligible only when effective_at_utc and independently proven source_available_at_utc are <= prediction_cutoff; unknown PIT is excluded.
identity_rule: Canonical participant/team IDs only. Fuzzy matching is never used for final feature attachment.
acceptance: Feature pattern is a candidate, not a promotion. Main chronological OOS, robustness, frozen holdout, PIT audit and release gates remain authoritative.
